description: This file defines a class 'MD5Crypt' that provides methods for encrypting, decrypting, and generating random passwords, specifically intended for session encryption purposes.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: A class providing methods for encrypting and decrypting session data, as well as generating random passwords using MD5 and XOR operations.

methods.name: keyED
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts text using a key, applying XOR with an MD5-hashed key.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts text with a supplied key, using a pseudo-random key generated with MD5 and base64 encoding.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts text that was encrypted with the 'Encrypt' method, reversing the process to retrieve original data.

methods.name: RandPass
methods.description: Generates a random 8-character password consisting of ASCII characters.
